title: Fixed Standing Rhythm Platform Station
description: One newly authored complete static standing rhythm-game station exterior. A single continuous thick ground chassis joins a tall sculpted display-and-speaker housing to a broad projecting nine-tile foot-control platform. Each chamfered tile is a real separate thick solid; four have physical raised directional triangle silhouettes. A single continuously curved return bar has two full roots and collars at the rear of the standing platform. The inclined front display is an opaque blank solid with a separate bezel and top header; two low circular speaker faces complete the upright body. All whole numerical shapes are new, not an old arcade cabinet or joystick deck copied onto an added floor, not a seated racer with its seat removed, and not a changed screen texture. Three constant opaque untextured PBR roles, metres, native Z up, whole horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. One complete prop, zero scenes. Static visual only: no player, game/software, rhythm sensing, electronics, moving buttons, input response, screen-replacement API, human fit, exercise guidance, grip strength, load rating or safety claim.
